title: Quality Dense Japanese Buckwheat Oyakodon
description: A dense and festive Japanese dish featuring buckwheat, coconut cream, and a hint of mustard, perfect for a special occasion. This shojin-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional oyakodon.
instructions: Rinse the buckwheat and soak it in water for 30 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Reconstitute the dried shiitake mushrooms in 1 cup of hot water and slice them into thin strips.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the sliced scallions and pickled ginger until fragrant.
Add the reconstituted mushrooms, mustard paste, and soy sauce to the skillet and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the buckwheat to the skillet and stir-fry for 5 minutes, or until it is well coated with the mushroom and mustard mixture.
Stir in the coconut cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the mixture is heated through.
Serve the buckwheat oyakodon hot, garnished with additional scallions and pickled ginger if desired.
Let the dish cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing.
Reheat the dish gently before serving, adding a splash of soy sauce or sesame oil if needed.
